description.narrative:
Economy-wide effects: The project boosts Ethiopia's economy though increased local value addition and job creation, promoting local feed production. By strengthening linkages with suppliers, it supports economic diversification and addresses unemployment challenges.
Stakeholder effects: Livestock farmers benefit from better-quality compound feeds and technical support. The project helps address crop and livestock productivity gaps but faces supply risks due to conflict in key regions.
Market creation effect: The investment introduces innovations in feed formulation, marketing, and bulk storage to strengthen Ethiopia's livestock feed market. By using food processing byproducts, Alema Koudijs lowers costs and improves margins, while expanded storage ensures supply stability. Aligned with national and World Bank initiatives, the project fosters systemic changes, though competitor capacity limitations may constrain broader scalability.

The proposed investment in Alema Koudijs Feed PLC (AKF or the Company) is to support the Company's expansion program on the existing feed mill in Bishoftu, Ethiopia (the Project). The Project is expected to be supported by the International Development Association's Private Sector Window Local Currency Facility (IDA-PSW LCF), as described in the Blended Finance Section.
